text: Benjamin Christensen's silent essay moves from medieval woodcuts and a model of Hell into staged scenes of [Satan tempting a sleeping woman from her husband's bed|threat|the devil and dark gods]. When the printer Jesper dies, his family accuses old Maria the weaver, who [names other women under torture|wrong|innocents wrongly punished], until Jesper's own wife Anna is [sentenced to burn at the stake|images|ropes, cages and executions]. The film closes by setting a nun, a sleepwalker and a woman sent to an asylum beside the pyres, suggesting the accused suffered [disorders of the mind|origin|a mind turning on itself].
